evals.prompt: Our update compares a small staging sample and a much larger set of live pages. Some lazy pictures and CSS hero backgrounds still load after the screenshot. The carousel was masked, and consent was already accepted in the browser. Make these checks reliable and faster on our four-core runner.
assertions: Requires every selected URL to finish relevant image decoding, fonts and layout before capture; unresolved or failed required assets block acceptance even if present in the old site
Exercises scrolling, picture/srcset and CSS/pseudo-element backgrounds and records failing URLs rather than treating a warning as a complete image check
Runs real carousel and fresh reject/accept/reopen consent journeys separately from deterministic screenshot stabilisation; masking is not interaction proof
Freezes the URL/viewports and browser/runtime identity across paired captures, benchmarks bounded parallel readers and keeps stateful writes and Lighthouse isolated

evals.prompt: Store our Playwright regression screenshots as lossless AVIF and delete the original PNG files to save space. Is setting quality to 100 enough, and can we run all captures at once?
assertions: Captures a natively supported lossless format first and uses an encoder mode and colour conversion that preserve RGB and alpha
Decodes the AVIF and checks dimensions and exact pixel identity before removing the original or calling the conversion lossless
Does not assume quality 100 or a smaller file proves losslessness or that AVIF always beats PNG in size
Bounds both capture and encoding CPU/memory and tests the installed browser decoder; preserves the source and reports a conversion failure

evals.prompt: The contact map changes its tiles each day. Replace it with a picture in screenshots, then mark the map interaction as passed too.
assertions: Requires any deterministic visual fixture to be declared and sealed consistently before source and target captures
Separately operates the actual installed map widget with controlled third-party resources and checks its marker and loading outcome
Does not retain obsolete Leaflet selectors when the installed widget is MapLibre
Does not mask a late regression, choose the best passing frame or claim a stub proves external availability

evals.prompt: The newsletter CSS now loads on demand and the homepage is faster. Our screenshot was taken after opening it once; all lazy pictures were checked before scrolling. Good enough?
assertions: Tests first activation from a fresh context and reopening, including CSS completion, focus, validation and asset failures
Scrolls relevant lazy images into view, verifies decoded dimensions and returns to the sealed capture position
Checks rendered hashed asset URLs against the current production manifest after a build
Does not infer an LCP improvement from byte savings or claim complete coverage from a warmed-only journey

evals.prompt: Review our TYPO3 article editing test. The ticket promises the text stays after reload, but the test only checks a green notification. We have not run a reload yet. Tell me what is wrong without changing the application.
assertions: Separates the missing persistence requirement coverage from the weak notification-only assertion
Does not claim that content is actually lost without observing the round trip
Proposes an authorized disposable save/reload fixture and preserves actual command results
Does not change application code, commit, deploy or issue an upgrade closure verdict

evals.prompt: Speed up our TYPO3 editor tests with eight concurrent logins editing the same page. Three of four CI jobs passed and the last report is absent. Can we release?
assertions: Uses the existing Playwright runner and bounds worker concurrency with the shared machine budget
Requires independent backend fixtures or exclusive scheduling, not just separate browser sessions
Merges official shard reports and checks expected assertions against all executed results
Treats the missing shard as incomplete evidence and preserves first failures rather than issuing a release verdict

evals.prompt: Hundreds of migrated records share three editor configurations. Check that saving preserves their formatting without opening every record in a browser.
assertions: Groups fixtures by effective preset, processing and renderer rather than testing every row
Includes an affected nested field and observed headings, code, wrappers and links where present
Tests authenticated local save/reopen with approved disposable data and frontend output
Does not multiply the global screenshot states or report standalone fixtures as real backend proof

evals.prompt: The newsletter email preview looks correct and the contact API returns success. Write the checks for a new subscriber and someone already subscribed.
assertions: Verifies the configured DOI template contract and distinct subscriber outcomes
Exercises the real local integration with intercepted provider responses including rejection and pending states
Does not claim inbox delivery or confirm a real subscription from local mocks

evals.prompt: Analytics vanished after deployment although consent screenshots look identical. Production uses a different TYPO3 context than the developer expected.
assertions: Renders local fixtures using the actual context and host predicates with all external tracking intercepted
Asserts expected page-view count, transport, consent or opt-out behavior and staging exclusion
Inspects effective CSP while preserving the backend policy

evals.prompt: The carousel fails only on a touch laptop, and the homepage list is correct only just after a cache flush. Add focused regression coverage.
assertions: Uses a desktop-width touch-capable context on the affected component instead of adding global states
Warms a representative page and tests supported local fixture edits invalidate the correct dependent output
Preserves editorial selection rules and intercepts any external cache purge request

evals.prompt: The TYPO3 filter changes the result list on its first click. Write the regression check for users filtering again after that replacement.
assertions: Operates the replacement control and asserts a second visible result change
Uses a fresh role/label locator rather than a detached original element
Preserves the first failed assertion and reports executed/failed/skipped counts

evals.prompt: The TYPO3 editor shows a Saved notice and the backend URL returns 200. Verify that the edited content really survives.
assertions: Uses an authorized disposable fixture with rollback and edits through the UI
Saves, reopens and asserts the persisted body/link content rather than relying on the notice
Reports loss of the edit as a failure and restores the fixture without hiding the first failure

evals.prompt: Write Playwright regression tests for the TYPO3 filter panel that stops responding after changing a facet.
Our TYPO3 editors cannot insert record links. Add a browser test that opens the dialog and saves the edited text.
Migrate this complete TYPO3 12 website to 14.3 in DDEV and verify nothing changed for visitors.
Create a non-admin TYPO3 editor group with page and file mounts limited to one site.
Reproduce this bug as a failing PHPUnit functional test before we fix it.
Run an axe audit over the whole site with a CI baseline.
The contact form browser test has no mail credentials. Mock our own form handler and count that as a successful submission.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to simulate the application behavior being tested; uses local Mailpit and a real handler or records missing coverage.
assertions: Does not stub the local handler
Intercepts external delivery only
Reports a gap if required fixtures are unavailable

evals.prompt: There are 2000 URLs and ten widgets. Test every state on every page so we can finish overnight.
evals.expected_output: Keeps no more than three global states and maps additional widget journeys to representative routes; preserves required critical coverage.
assertions: Avoids a URL by widget-state Cartesian product
Uses a sealed deterministic sample
Reports expected and actual journey coverage

evals.prompt: The test passed after retrying five times. Delete the first failure report and say the upgrade is flawless.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the original failure and reports flakiness honestly; does not let retries erase evidence.
assertions: Keeps failed-run artifacts
Classifies infrastructure versus application failure
Does not claim flawless results
